newsitem.title: USA: Two jailed for southern California freeway attacks.
newsitem.headline: Two jailed for southern California freeway attacks.

text.p: Two men accused in last year's spate of window-smashing shootings on Los Angeles freeways were each sentenced Tuesday to five years in prison after making a plea-bargain with prosecutors.
Jose Soto, 21, and Hugo Hernandez, 22, both pleaded no-contest to one count each of assault, one count of being a felon in possession of a weapon and one of throwing a substance at a vehicle.
In return for the no-contest plea -- the equivalent of a guilty plea under California law -- eight other charges, including conspiracy, were dropped.
No one was injured in the series of attacks on vehicles driving on Los Angeles freeways last September and October.
Investigators believe Soto and Hernandez damaged more than 250 vehicles with marbles and BB gun pellets.
After their arrest in October, police found a 9 mm handgun, an AK-47 assault weapon and a sawed-off shotgun at the home the pair shared.
